facts.fact: EgyptInnovate reports that the digital SME lender Flend raised US$3 million in a seed round of equity led by Egypt Ventures and debt from MSMEDA and local banks.
EgyptInnovate reports that Egyptian investors including Egypt Ventures, Banque Misr and El Sewedy joined Flend's US$3 million seed round, with debt from MSMEDA and local banks.

note: Round undated in the body; month is the page's date.
